about.history: I am currently pursuing my studies in Informatics at Universitas Kelabat, where I am in my 5th semester. My academic journey has been driven by a strong fascination with the intersection of technology and user experience. I am particularly interested in UI/UX design, exploring how to create intuitive and engaging interfaces. This interest naturally extends into game development, where I am deeply fascinated by how games are crafted, from their core mechanics to their visual and interactive design. I strive to apply these principles to create compelling digital experiences. My focus lies in exploring the technical and creative aspects that bring virtual worlds to life.
about.focus: UI/UX Design • Game Development • Frontend Development • Interactive Interfaces
